features.description: docs/plans/2026-10-28-U1-read-views.md: the view.mjs API, the status.mjs stdin and JSON contract, the existing checks the new text affects with their intent-preserving rewrites, and the order of U1's features so the suite stays green between them.
steps: `docs/plans/2026-10-28-U1-read-views.md` exists and opens with one line on the lanes state: P1 and P2 of run agent-harness-2026-10-26 are on `origin/main` (PRs #40 and #41; `lib/lane.sh` and `lib/record.sh` exist), so every driver site is named by function and file (`sync_main`, `merge_one`, `needs_you`, `notify_park` in lib/record.sh; `verify` in lib/lane.sh; `finish` and the EXIT trap in lib/driver.sh; `cmd_status`, `cmd_queue`, `cmd_parked` in bin/harness), never by a line number

it fixes `lib/view.mjs`'s exported API with one signature and a one-line contract each (`context`, `glyph`, `paint`, `displayWidth`, `cut`, `pad`, `table`, `section`, `rule`, `card`, `ago`, `when`, `home`, `duration`, `endClass`), the glyph table (`● ✓ ✗ ■ ‖ ⚠ ○ · ─ …` and the ASCII `* + x # = ! o - - ...`), the width rule (`COLUMNS` when a whole number of at least 40, else the TTY's width, else 100; narrow below 72) and the colour and override rules (`NO_COLOR`, `TERM=dumb`, `HARNESS_COLOR`, `HARNESS_TTY`, `HARNESS_GLYPHS`, `HARNESS_NOW`)

it fixes `lib/status.mjs`'s stdin line (`<run>\t<project>\t<state dir>\t<worktree>\t<record dir>\t<alive 0|1|2>`), its arguments (the runner's pid state, the queue dir, the ledger dir, MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS), what node reads itself (`ended`, `PAUSE`, `LIMIT_UNTIL`, `port`, `tests-start`/`tests-end`, `run.log`, `metrics.jsonl`, `feature_list.json`, `summary.json` from the state dir then the ledger copy `<ledger>/<project>/<run>/summary.json`), what bash passes in (alive pids, units with MemoryCurrent when `-v` or `--json`), and the v1 `--json` document with every key of the spec's run object and queue entry

it lists by file and check name every existing check the new text affects and the intent-preserving rewrite of each: "ended: done; status says so" in tests/checks/08-, 13-, 14- and 15-; "harness status lists a running run's units with MemoryCurrent; an ended run's none" (08-); "lanes status: harness status prints one line per open lane (feature, session, port, slot, its units with MemoryCurrent), no bare line for a lane's unit" (47-lanes-two.sh); "queue list marks continuations (requested) or (automatic)" and "a request for a run with an automatic continuation queued makes that one requested; parked entries are marked too" (15-); "--dry-run prints the context, launches nothing" (15-); the desk prompt check in 13- that names `harness parked parky`

it orders U1-02 to U1-07 with what the suite looks like after each (the old `harness status <run>` text is kept until U1-05 replaces it, so every check stays green between features), names the check files (one per topic, numbered from 51) and fixtures (`tests/fixtures/end-reasons.txt` copied from the reasons `finish` is called with and the spec's `ended` lines, `tests/fixtures/status-json-keys.txt`), the stub-state helper the checks share (one run done 2 h ago, one done 3 d ago, one stopped, one running, one parked, one given up, one gc'd with a ledger copy, 30 more for timing), and Michael's after-run step (`STATUS_SINCE` in the user config, optional)
the suite is green (unchanged by this feature)

features.description: lib/view.mjs, the one formatter every read view renders through: width and layout from the environment, a fixed single-column glyph set with an ASCII fallback, colour on a TTY only, tables that never exceed the width, cards with a hanging indent, relative and absolute times, durations and end classes, each a pure function with unit checks.
steps: `lib/view.mjs` has a one-line usage header, imports nothing beyond `node:` built-ins, and exports `context`, `glyph`, `paint`, `displayWidth`, `cut`, `pad`, `table`, `section`, `rule`, `card`, `ago`, `when`, `home`, `duration`, `endClass`; `node --check lib/view.mjs` passes

`context({env, isTTY, columns})` unit checks in a new check file by topic (e.g. `tests/checks/51-view-pure.sh`): `COLUMNS=60` gives width 60 and narrow true; `COLUMNS=80` gives 80 and narrow false; `COLUMNS=junk` or `COLUMNS=20` off a TTY gives 100; a TTY of 120 columns with no `COLUMNS` gives 120; `HARNESS_TTY=1` gives tty true off a TTY; colour is false with `NO_COLOR=1`, with `TERM=dumb` and off a TTY, true on a TTY otherwise and true with `HARNESS_COLOR=always` even under `NO_COLOR=1`; `LC_ALL=C` gives ASCII glyphs, `LANG=en_US.UTF-8` unicode, `HARNESS_GLYPHS=ascii` overrides a UTF-8 locale

every glyph of the fixed set (`●` running, `✓` done, `✗` failed, `■` stopped, `‖` paused, `⚠` needs you, `○` queued, `·` separator, `─` rule, `…` cut) has `displayWidth` 1, is a text-presentation code point (no emoji, no `⏸`), and has its ASCII form (`* + x # = ! o - - ...`); `displayWidth` ignores ANSI escape sequences and counts `漢` as 2

`cut("ab漢cd", 4, ctx)` never splits a code point and ends in `…` (unicode) or `...` (ascii); `pad` right-aligns numbers; every line of `table` stays within the width at 40, 60, 80 and 120 columns for rows with a 60-character id and a 300-character reason, the id never cut and the flex column cut with the ellipsis; `section("NEEDS YOU", 1, "harness needs", ctx)` fills to the width with the rule glyph; `card` word-wraps a 200-character value under an 11-wide label column with a hanging indent and leaves a URL line whole past the width

`ago` gives `now`, `4m`, `3h`, `2d`, `5w` for epochs 0 s, 240 s, 3 h, 2 d and 5 w before `HARNESS_NOW`; `when` gives `2026-10-27 00:19 (10h ago)` under `TZ=UTC` for the matching epochs; `duration` turns `30m`, `6h`, `2d`, `1w` and `2026-10-20` into seconds (the date relative to `HARNESS_NOW`) and fails on `abc`; `home` shortens a path under the home directory to a tilde and leaves other paths as they are

`tests/fixtures/end-reasons.txt` holds, one per line, every reason `finish` is called with in lib/driver.sh and lib/lane.sh plus the `ended` lines of the spec's *What Michael saw* section, sanitised; a check runs `endClass` over every line and gets `done`, `stopped`, `waiting` or `failed` exactly as the spec's end-class table says, and `some new reason` gives `failed`
every new check name is in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; the suite is green

features.description: lib/status.mjs builds the run and queue objects from the state dirs, the ledger and the queue in one node process, and `harness status --json` (v1) prints them; the text output is unchanged in this feature.
steps: `lib/status.mjs` (usage header; imports only `node:` built-ins and `./view.mjs`) reads one run per stdin line (`<run>\t<project>\t<state dir>\t<worktree>\t<record dir>\t<alive 0|1|2>`) and the arguments `--runner 0|1 --queue <dir> --ledger <dir> --max-parallel <k>`, exports pure `runObject`, `queueEntry` and `sections`, and reads per run itself `ended`, `PAUSE`, the state root's `LIMIT_UNTIL`, `port`, `tests-start`/`tests-end`, `run.log` (the newest `session <n> · <id> · <model>` line and the run's first ` run <id> on ` line), `metrics.jsonl` (cost, the session count), `feature_list.json`, and for a run whose worktree is gone `summary.json` from the state dir, else the ledger's `<project>/<run>/summary.json`

`harness status --json` prints one JSON document with `v: 1`, `generated_at`, `since`, `runner: {up, max_parallel_runs}`, `needs`, `running`, `queued`, `finished`, `older`; each run object has exactly the spec's keys (`run, project, state, end_reason, end_class, started_at, ended_at, feature, session, model, features: {passing, total, verified, merged}, cost_usd, tests: {start, end}, port, branch, worktree, worktree_exists, record, state_dir, needs, lanes, units`), each queue entry `n, verb, project, run, spec, brief_head, brief_chars, until, mark, added_at, held, overlap`; `tests/fixtures/status-json-keys.txt` lists every key path and a check compares the output's sorted key paths with it; `harness status <run> --json` prints that one run object

a new check file by topic (e.g. `tests/checks/52-status-json.sh`) builds stub state dirs through a helper other files can source: one run done 2 h ago, one done 3 d ago, one `stopped by Michael: x`, one running (a sleeping stub `driver.pid`), one with a parked feature in `parked.json`, one given up (`attempts.json` at `MAX_ATTEMPTS`, ended `blocked on A`), one whose worktree is removed with a ledger copy of `summary.json` saying 23/23, and 30 more ended runs for timing; `HARNESS_NOW` fixes the clock

with those: `state` is `running` for the live run, `ended` for the done ones and `crashed` for a `driver.pid` naming no process with no `ended`; `end_class` is `done`, `stopped` and `waiting` (the given-up run's `blocked on A`) as `endClass` says; the gc'd run's `features.passing` and `features.total` are 23 from the ledger copy and `worktree_exists` is false; `needs` of the parked and the given-up run is 1 and of the gc'd run 0; `finished` holds the runs ended inside the window (default `24h`, else `STATUS_SINCE` from the user config, else `--since 4d`, which adds the 3-day-old run) but at least the 3 newest ended runs and at most 10, newest first, and `older` counts the rest; `--all` puts every ended run in `finished` with `older` 0; `--project proj2` keeps only that project's runs

`queued` holds the queue entries as `harness queue list` numbers them, with `held` true for an entry whose project has a live run (the runner's `busy_projects` rule) and `brief_head` the first 30 characters of its `--brief`; the queue dir is read, never created

`harness status --json` over the 38 stub runs finishes under 1 s (the check measures with `date +%s%N`), and the text of `harness status` and `harness status <run>` is unchanged by this feature (the 08-, 13-, 14-, 15- and 47- checks pass as they are); `journal/decisions/2026-10-27-read-views.md` is started with title, provenance and the finding
`node --check lib/status.mjs`, `bash -n bin/harness`; every new check name is in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; the suite is green

features.description: `harness status` is one screen: NEEDS YOU, RUNNING, QUEUED and FINISHED sections with a footer, `--all`, `--since`, `--project`, `-v` and `N`, fitting 60 and 80 columns with colour on a TTY only; the per-run card keeps its old text until U1-05.
steps: `harness status` with no run argument renders through `lib/status.mjs` and `lib/view.mjs`: four sections in this order, `NEEDS YOU <n> · harness needs`, `RUNNING <n>`, `QUEUED <n> · runner going|off (harness queue start)`, `FINISHED · last <window> · <n>`, each a `section` line even when empty (`QUEUED 0 · runner off`), then a rule and the footer `<k> older runs: harness status --all · --since 3d · one run: harness status <run>` whenever anything is hidden; `harness status` on an empty state root prints the four empty sections

rows: NEEDS YOU lists each parked feature (`parked.json`), each `needs-<m>`, `refused-<m>` and `conflict-<m>` marker and each run ended `blocked on …`, `waiting on Michael: …` or with a failed class, as glyph, run, a short headline, `x/y` passing, whole-dollar cost and age, block items first then oldest first, and a run whose worktree is gone lists no item; RUNNING lists live drivers oldest start first with `●`, `‖` (PAUSE) or `⚠` (ending with an item) and the *what* column `<feature> · session <n> · <model alias>`, `waiting for the usage limit until HH:MM`, `paused`, or `2 lanes` with one indented sub-row per open lane; QUEUED shows the first 3 entries then `+<k> more: harness queue list`; FINISHED is newest first with the end class glyph and the reason cut with the ellipsis

with the stub runs of U1-03's helper: the four section lines appear in that order; the parked and the given-up run are under NEEDS YOU; the 3-day-old run is only in the footer count and appears with `--since 4d`; `--all` lists every run; `--project proj2` lists only that project's; the gc'd run shows `23/23`; no `run.log` line is printed; `COLUMNS=60 harness status` and `COLUMNS=80 harness status` have no line over 60 and 80 display columns (measured with `displayWidth`), and at 60 the long field is on an indented second line

no ESC byte in the output without `HARNESS_TTY=1`; an ESC byte with `HARNESS_TTY=1`; none with `HARNESS_TTY=1 NO_COLOR=1`; under `LC_ALL=C` no byte over 0x7f (ASCII glyphs only); every path printed has the home directory shortened to a tilde

`-v` adds to each running row its units with `MemoryCurrent`, P2-06's lane lines with their text unchanged, and the last `N` lines of `run.log` (default 3); the environment variable `N` alone implies `-v` (`N=20 harness status` prints up to 20 log lines per running run); `harness status --all` over the 38 stub runs stays under 1 s

`journal/decisions/2026-10-27-read-views.md` gains the choice (one formatter, no pager, colour on a TTY only, the window rule: `24h`, never fewer than the 3 newest, never more than 10) and the rejected (a pager by default, colour off a TTY, `column(1)` or an npm table package, hiding NEEDS YOU when the window is short, per-command formatting code)
`node --check lib/status.mjs lib/view.mjs`, `bash -n bin/harness`; every new check name is in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; the suite is green

features.description: `harness status <run>` is a card (state line, rule, labelled fields, `-v` log tail), the debrief's and supervisor's reads keep working, and the existing checks that asserted the old text are rewritten to their intent.
steps: `harness status <run>` prints a card: first line `<glyph> <run> · <project> · <running|paused|limit_wait|ending|crashed|end class> · <x/y> passing · <ago>` (since the start while running, since the end after), a rule, then the labelled fields `now` (running: feature, session, attempt of max, model, minutes in), `ended` (`when` and the full reason), `milestones` (`P0 ✓ merged 4/4 · P1 3/6 · P2 0/7` from the list and the `verified-`/`merged-` markers), `lanes` (P2-06's lane lines, their text unchanged, running only), `spend` (cents like `$69.06`, sessions, wall hours, `tests 419 → 430`), `branch` (name, `<n> ahead, <m> behind` origin/main from local refs, no fetch), `worktree` (path, or `removed by gc`), `needs you` (count and `harness needs <run>`), `units` (running only, MemoryCurrent), `next` (those that apply of `harness show`, `report`, `continue`, `attach`); `-v` or `N` adds the log tail as the last field

the existing checks keep their intent with the new text: "ended: done; status says so" in tests/checks/08-, 13-, 14- and 15- reads the card's first line (`· done ·`) and `harness status demo --json`'s `end_reason`; "harness status lists a running run's units with MemoryCurrent; an ended run's none" (08-) reads `-v`'s `units` field; "lanes status: harness status prints one line per open lane (feature, session, port, slot, its units with MemoryCurrent), no bare line for a lane's unit" (47-lanes-two.sh) reads the `lanes` field, whose `lane M1 · A · session <n> · port 7950 · slot 0 · MemoryCurrent …` text is P2-06's

new checks in a file by topic (e.g. `tests/checks/54-status-card.sh`): the first line of `harness status <run>` for a stub run has the run, the project, the class and `x/y passing`; `N=3 harness status <run>` ends with exactly 3 `run.log` lines; the gc'd run's card says `removed by gc` under `worktree` and `23/23` from the ledger; `COLUMNS=60` card lines never exceed 60 columns except a URL; `harness status nope` exits 1 with `harness: ` on stderr

the debrief's gatherer is unchanged (`lib/debrief.sh` keeps `N=3 "$H" status "$RUN_ID"`) and the "--dry-run prints the context, launches nothing" check in tests/checks/15- still finds a `#### harness status` block per run whose first line names the run; `prompts/supervisor.md` says `harness status {{RUN_ID}} -v` and that `N=20` still works; `prompts/project-catchup.md` says `harness status --project

`
`bash -n bin/harness lib/debrief.sh`; every new check name is in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; the suite is green

features.description: `harness queue list` is sectioned rows through the formatter (a brief cut to 30 characters, held and parked entries explained), and `harness queue show <n>` prints one entry whole.
steps: `harness queue list` renders through the formatter: `QUEUE <n> · runner ● going|off · MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS=<k>` (narrow: `max <k>`), one row per entry `<n>  <verb>  <run id, or "<project> (new run)">  <mark>  <spec basenames> · brief "<first 30 characters>…" (+<k> chars)  <age>`, a second line `held: <project> busy (<run>)` for an entry the runner's `busy_projects` rule holds, `PARKED <n> (skipped; harness queue unpark <n>)` with `why: <reason>` per parked entry, `RUNNING <runs>`, `RECENT` with the runner log's last 5 lines (time only, the home directory shortened to a tilde), then a rule and `one entry in full: harness queue show <n>`; the numbering, the `(requested)` and `(automatic)` marks and `harness queue rm|park|unpark <n>` are unchanged

`harness queue show <n> [--parked]` prints the whole entry, one labelled field per line: verb, project path, run, the `--spec` files, the `--brief` word-wrapped in full, `--until` as a time, the marks, `why` for a parked one, and the `.args` file path

checks in a file by topic (e.g. `tests/checks/55-queue-view.sh`): an entry queued with a 1,200-character `--brief` shows 30 characters and `(+1170 chars)` in `queue list` and `harness queue show 1` prints all 1,200; an entry for a project with a live stub run has the `held:` line naming that run; a parked entry shows under PARKED with its `why:`; `COLUMNS=60` and `COLUMNS=80` output never exceeds the width; the existing "queue list marks continuations (requested) or (automatic)" and "a request for a run with an automatic continuation queued makes that one requested; parked entries are marked too" checks in tests/checks/15- read the new rows
`bash -n bin/harness`, `node --check` on every `.mjs` touched; every new check name is in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; the suite is green

steps: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib bin tests prompts templates docs/architecture.md README.md > /tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-10-28/U1-review.diff` is read by an Opus subagent; its findings, each with a severity, are in `docs/plans/2026-10-28-U1-review.md`; a second round runs only when the first found something Critical

`README.md`'s command table has `status` with `--all`, `--since`, `--project`, `-v`, `--json` and `queue show`, and its settings name `STATUS_SINCE` and `NO_COLOR`; `docs/architecture.md` §3 names `lib/view.mjs` and `lib/status.mjs` and §12 the queue view; `templates/user/config.sh` has `STATUS_SINCE` commented with one sentence; `journal/decisions/2026-10-27-read-views.md` is complete (finding · choice · rejected) and never numbered
`bash -n` on every shell file U1 touched and `node --check` on every `.mjs`; the suite is green

features.description: docs/plans/2026-10-28-U2-needs-record.md: the needs record's shape against the n8n event v1 keys, every stop path mapped to its function with the reason it opens and the rule that resolves it, the card template per reason, the inbox.mjs API, and the order of U2's features.
steps: `docs/plans/2026-10-28-U2-needs-record.md` fixes the record shape: the first 13 keys in the order of the event JSON v1 in `docs/specs/2026-10-22-n8n-events.md` (`v, id, at, kind, project, run, feature, title, body, priority, click, actions, context`), then `ref, key, reason, severity, milestone, seen, updated_at, card, resolved_at, resolved_by, resolved_why`, the `card` object's keys, and where the files live (`<state dir>/needs/<seq>.json`, `needs/done/`, the rendered `needs.md` in the run record)

it maps every stop path to its function and file as the code stands (`notify_park` and `needs_you` in lib/record.sh; the park branch and the given-up end in lib/lane.sh; `verify`'s three `needs-<m>` lines in lib/lane.sh; `merge_one` and `sync_main` in lib/record.sh; the base-conflict note in `slot_open`; `finish` and the EXIT trap in lib/driver.sh; `cmd_continue` in bin/harness) with the reason, kind, severity, priority and `key` subject each opens and the `sweep` rule that resolves it

it gives each of the 15 reasons' card template (headline, blocked, cost, a why of 2 to 4 sentences naming the mechanism and its file, where, options with one recommended, commands) and the fixture its unit check renders from, the `lib/needs.sh` helper's exact form `needs_open <reason> <subject> key=value…` with the bash variables it passes, the `lib/inbox.mjs` API (`answersLine`, `question`, `added`, the `repair` CLI), and the notification text that stays (`PARKED: <why>` as the first body line, `Answer: harness answer <run> "…"`, the titles `[<run>] <id> needs you` and `[<run>] <m> needs you`)

it orders U2-02 to U2-09, says what the suite looks like after each, names the check files and fixtures (`tests/fixtures/inbox-q-in-comment.md` from n8n-home commit `4632d1c`, `tests/fixtures/merge-tree-name-only.txt`, one fixture state dir per reason), lists the existing checks it touches by name (the three `parked.mjs` checks in tests/checks/03-, the desk prompt check in 13- naming `harness parked parky`, the park notification checks that read `PARKED:`), and Michael's after-run steps (the skill symlink; nothing live)
the suite is green (unchanged by this feature)

features.description: One INBOX parser (lib/inbox.mjs) that finds `## Answers` outside the steering comment, a repair the driver runs after each session for a question written inside the comment, and a template comment that no longer contains that text (bug a).
steps: `tests/fixtures/inbox-q-in-comment.md` is the n8n-home project's `.harness/runs/n8n-home-2026-10-22/INBOX.md` at its commit `4632d1c` (git show in that project's checkout), byte for byte: its line 13 reads `## Answers".` and its line 28 is `## Answers`

`lib/inbox.mjs` (usage header, pure, exported) has `answersLine(text)`, the index of the first line that is exactly `## Answers` (trailing spaces allowed) outside an HTML comment, an unclosed comment running to the end of the file; `question(text, feature)` (today's `questionFor`, cut at that line, comments removed first); `added(before, after)` (today's `inboxQuestion`, cut at that line); and a CLI `repair <before> <after>` that moves the lines the session added inside the steering comment to just above the `## Answers` line, restores the comment to its before-text, and exits 3 when it changed the file, 0 otherwise

unit checks in a new file by topic (e.g. `tests/checks/56-inbox-pure.sh`): on the fixture `answersLine` is line 28, not 13; `question(fixture, "B1-05")` starts with `**Q2 (B1-05` and contains no `<!--`; `repair` of the driver's template text plus a question planted inside the comment leaves the comment byte for byte as before and the question directly above `## Answers`; `added` on a before/after pair where the session wrote inside the comment returns that question
`lib/parked.mjs` and `lib/notify.mjs` import `inbox.mjs` instead of their own `/^## Answers/` cut, and the three `parked.mjs` checks in tests/checks/03- and every notification check pass unchanged

the driver's INBOX heredoc in lib/driver.sh no longer has the text `## Answers` inside its comment (it says to write answers under the Answers heading at the end of the file); after each session the lane runs `inbox.mjs repair` on the record's INBOX.md and on exit 3 notes `INBOX.md: <id>'s question was inside the steering comment (hidden on GitHub); moved below it`; a stub-run check with a stub session that writes its question inside the comment (a new `tests/stub-claude.sh` flag copying the n8n-home shape) finds that note in harness-log.md, the question above `## Answers` and the comment unchanged
`node --check lib/inbox.mjs lib/parked.mjs lib/notify.mjs`, `bash -n lib/driver.sh lib/lane.sh lib/record.sh`; every new check name is in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; the suite is green

features.description: lib/needs.mjs: the needs record (open with key refresh, sweep by reason, done, list, a synthesized driver crash), lib/needs.sh's `needs_open`, and `harness needs --json` plus `harness needs done <ref>`; nothing in the driver opens a record yet.
steps: `lib/needs.mjs` (usage header; `node:` built-ins and `./view.mjs` only) exports pure `record`, `refresh`, `sweep` and `synthesize` and has a CLI: `open <state dir> <run> <project> <reason> <subject> key=value…` writes `<state dir>/needs/<seq>.json` to a temporary name then renames it, exit 0 for a new item and exit 3 when an open item has the same `key` (`<reason>:<subject>`; then `seen` is incremented and `updated_at` and the card refreshed); `sweep <state dir>…` moves resolved items to `needs/done/` filling `resolved_at`, `resolved_by`, `resolved_why`; `done <state dir> <ref> [--why <text>]`; `list <state dir>… [--all] [--json]`

unit checks in a new file by topic (e.g. `tests/checks/57-needs-record.sh`): the first 13 keys of a written record equal, in order, the v1 event keys of `docs/specs/2026-10-22-n8n-events.md` and `kind` is one of `park`, `needs_michael`, `blocked`, `limit`; `open` twice with one key gives one file with `seen: 2` and exits 0 then 3; the reason table holds for every reason (`parked`, `given_up`, `verify_thin`, `verify_red`, `verify_recheck`, `merge_conflict`, `merge_refused`, `main_conflict`, `base_conflict`, `feature_list_edits`, `initializer_failed`, `driver_crash`, `usage_limit`, `weekly_budget`, `overlap`: kind, severity `block|warn`, priority `high` or empty); `ref` is `<run>/<seq>`
